accuracy.title: How accurate is Google Maps for these bus stops?
accuracy.intro: A full audit comparing the locations Google Maps shows against the official coordinates published by the Kagoshima City Transportation Bureau, for all 20 City View bus stops.
accuracy.sameSpot: No. 1 and No. 20 are the same location (Kagoshima-Chuo Station).
accuracy.baseline: The baseline coordinates used for comparison were verified to match the official values published by the Kagoshima City Transportation Bureau for all 20 stops (verified 2026-07-20).
accuracy.method: Method: for each stop's Japanese name, we searched Google Maps and measured the distance (haversine) between the top candidate and the official coordinates. Under 50m is within smartphone GPS error ('OK'); 100m or more is graded 'Wrong'.

problem.title:
Google Maps is wrong,
and there are no signs
problem.item1: Google Maps points to the wrong location. One traveler waited 10 minutes and missed the bus.
problem.item2: There are no English or Korean signs at stops. Some foreign travelers didn't know to board when the bus arrived.
problem.item3: Accurate multilingual info in one place is hard to find. This app fills that gap.

home.spotsLead: The City View bus leaves Kagoshima-Chuo Station, circles {{count}} stops and comes back to the station. Here are a few places worth hopping off for.
home.routeRailLabel: {{count}} stops on the City View route

saigo.title: Saigō Takamori Statue
saigo.body: A statue honoring Saigō Takamori, a leading figure of the Meiji Restoration, at the foot of Shiroyama beside Central Park.

shiroyama.title: Shiroyama Observatory
shiroyama.body: A lookout on a hill about 107 m high, with the city, Kinko Bay and Sakurajima all in one view.

senganen.title: Sengan-en
senganen.body: The Shimazu family garden villa, which borrows Sakurajima as its mountain and Kinko Bay as its pond.

ferry.title: Sakurajima Ferry
ferry.body: The ferry terminal is right by the Aquarium stop. Sakurajima is about 15 minutes away by ferry.
